title: Count adjacent repeats in a list
prompt:
Count the positions i (from the second element on) where the element **equals its predecessor**. Use `.equals` — these are Integer objects.

Example: `[1,1,2,2,2,3]` → `3`.

tests.name: adjacent repeat count
tests.hint: Loop from i = 1; list.get(i).equals(list.get(i - 1)) — never == on objects.
